materialChanges: Reclassified the clinical synthesis as claims-mapped, linked its four applicable claims, and added a same-scene source note.
Changed the apple worked example from a time-to-threshold outcome with an undefined not-reached case to browning level recorded at 60 minutes.
Replaced new clinical-section terminology with the established case-or-contrast, observable-record, boundary, and open-outcome builder.
Completed the clinical scene's glossary navigation and corrected both attribution references from version 0.1.0 to 0.2.0.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The clinical synthesis is now claims-mapped; claim-observation-explanation, claim-empirical-question, claim-bounded-question, and claim-description-not-causation include scene-clinical-wrap-up; and the scene exposes those claims and source-nrc-framework in a learner-visible source note.
The worked example now records browning level for every slice at 60 minutes and asks how the levels compare, so no undefined event time remains when a slice does not reach a threshold.

The finding confirms that the three answer keys, rubrics, outcome performances, ten-point total, and non-causal acceptable responses are already academically correct; the final cross-check retained that assessment logic unchanged.
The clinical synthesis is now declared claims-mapped and its applicable claims are mapped to the scene with learner-visible source support.
Section 3 now evaluates the question using the lesson's established four-part vocabulary: case or contrast, observable record, boundary, and open outcome.
scene-clinical-wrap-up was added to term-observation, term-testable-question, and term-boundary; it was also added to term-empirical because the scene explicitly uses 'empirically answerable'.
Both learner-content and suggested-attribution version references in ATTRIBUTION.md now state 0.2.0, matching the unchanged structured lesson version.

evidenceChecked: All five scenes retain semantic source order, exactly one level-one heading, and only level-two subheadings; essential meaning is present in text.

The lesson explicitly permits prose, bullets, or a table plus typing, local dictation, and assistive technology, and it does not depend on color, images, dragging, speed, physical apple preparation, or laboratory access.
The assessment is untimed and retakeable, with prompts before answer reveal, reasoning-rich feedback, rubrics, retry cases, and a text response route.
The pack contains no figures, diagrams, audio, video, datasets, or third-party assets requiring a missing sensory equivalent or asset attribution.
The clinical and campus-health cases are explicitly fictional or invented, make no treatment claim, require no identity or personal medical details, and direct no clinical action.
The scene Markdown contains no raw HTML, HTML entities, scripts, executable content, Markdown images, remote embeds, or unsafe active media; lesson paths are local and no symlinks are present.
Each claims-mapped scene has a learner-visible source note, and every claim-to-scene and claim-to-source link was cross-checked after revision.

The sole reference is recorded as an official standard used only for factual reference under facts-only original expression, with no copied source expression, media, table, figure, dataset, or example.
The reference records a dated checked-no-agent-restriction-found access state and a concrete terms URL; the displayed license field is within the required length.
ATTRIBUTION.md identifies the source use, original fictional cases, absence of third-party assets and datasets, CC BY 4.0 grant, accountable principal, and material agent assistance.
limitations: No live screen-reader, browser, 200-percent zoom, narrow-viewport, print, or non-web export test was performed in this file-only run.
The public schemas and repository validators were not read or run because the operator expressly excluded site access and npm execution; validation is therefore a required operator condition.
The source-access and rights records were inspected, but the National Academies source and current terms pages were not independently re-fetched in this run.

rationale: Exactly two provided advisory reviews count for standard-lesson-v3: one academic and one learning-design record against the same original candidate, with distinct disclosed run IDs and providers, no declared conflicts, and two request-changes verdicts. No provided review was excluded. The operator reports equivalent non-dismissed GitHub Comment transports; that external state was not independently queried in this file-only run. Every indexed finding is disposed above. The bounded revision resolves the false claim-coverage declaration, evidence visibility, censored worked-example outcome, terminology drift, glossary navigation, and attribution mismatch while preserving the assessment the academic reviewer found correct. Manual JSON, linkage, heading, claim-note, answer-type, reference-field, rights, privacy, security, and diff checks found no remaining blocker. The accessibility-and-rights audit is satisfied subject to its stated test limitations and the operator conditions below. The provenance diversity recorded here is disclosed and attested, not independently verified.
dissent: The academic review requested changes to the original candidate for the clinical scene's missing claim trace and the apple example's unobserved threshold-time case; both concerns are incorporated in the final revision.

The learning-design review requested changes to the original candidate for clinical claim coverage, terminology drift, incomplete glossary navigation, and attribution-version mismatch; all four concerns are incorporated in the final revision.
